name: OpenGUI
description: Automate your phone for everyday tasks, app testing, content operations, chat and more. Say what you need, and let it take action. After initial setup and authorization, just plug in your phone and go. Leave repetitive tasks to AI, take back your time, and unleash your imagination.
description_zh: 自动操作你的手机，处理日常事务、测试 App、运营、聊天……说出你的需求，它来动手。 首次安装并授权后，即插即用。把繁琐操作交给 AI，把时间留给自己，释放你的想象力。
description_en: Automate your phone for everyday tasks, app testing, content operations, chat and more. Say what you need, and let it take action. After initial setup and authorization, just plug in your phone and go. Leave repetitive tasks to AI, take back your time, and unleash your imagination.
examples_zh: /opengui 在小红书App中搜索“美食”，帮我获取前3篇贴子的内容整理给我。
/opengui 帮我打开微信App，查看有哪些未读的好友或群消息，告诉我好友/群的名字和未读条数。
examples_en: /opengui Search for “美食” in Xiaohongshu, retrieve the content of the first 3 posts, and organize it for me.
/opengui Open WeChat and check which friend or group conversations have unread messages. Tell me each friend/group name and its unread message count.
